notifications.title: Vendor Request submitted
notifications.message: Vendor request has been submitted for approval. Please review the request and take necessary action.

notifications.title: Vendor Request approved
notifications.message: Vendor request has been approved. You can proceed with the transfer process.

notifications.title: Vendor Request rejected
notifications.message: Vendor request has been rejected. Please contact the vendor for further clarification.

notifications.title: Transfer completed
notifications.message: The transfer process has been completed successfully. Please check the inventory for updated stock levels.

notifications.title: Transfer failed
notifications.message: The transfer process has failed due to insufficient stock. Please review the inventory and try again.
